cleared_tunnel_gx.note: lantern flickers (4 frames). Place it BESIDE the open path, entrance facing it (never on the path): path along gy -> use _gx on the upper-left side (anchor = path centre + (-48,-24) px); path along gx -> use _gy on the upper-right side (anchor = path centre + (32,-16) px); path runs along gx (screen \): obstacle lies across it; anchor = ground centre, put it in the middle of the path

lip_ul.note: draw on a LOWER tile (path/sand) when the back neighbour on that edge is higher: grass droops over it

fringe_ul.note: draw on a grass tile (shifted up by 6 px) when the back neighbour on that edge is lower

lip_ur.note: draw on a LOWER tile (path/sand) when the back neighbour on that edge is higher: grass droops over it

terrain.note: hill_* is a grass block on a rock cliff, HILL_T px tall: place its top diamond HILL_T px above the ground diamond. ramp_* : image has HILL_T px of headroom, the ground diamond starts at y = HILL_T + 1 (tile_center = [33, HILL_T + 17]); flanks are rock (match hill_*); 'rises_toward' is the direction the surface RISES toward (-gx = screen up-left, -gy = up-right, +gx = down-right, +gy = down-left)
